rounds.sentence: Loko buloho ri pfariwile, hi ta tirhisa ndlela ya le henhla ka ntshava ku ya emutini.
rounds.story: 'buloho ri pfariwile' ni 'ku ya emutini' swi komba patu yo hundza.

rounds.sentence: Eka nhlengeletano ya vatswari, nhloko ya xikolo yi hlamusele milawu leyintshwa.
options: xirho xa miri xa le henhla
xiphemu xa le henhla xa nchumu
rounds.story: 'ya xikolo' ni 'yi hlamusele milawu' swi komba murhangeri, ku nga ri xirho xa miri.

rounds.sentence: Mhaka leyi yi yisiwe ekhotweni hikuva vamakelwani va kanetana hi ndzilakano.
rounds.story: 'yisiwe ekhotweni' ni 'va kanetana' swi komba nandzu.

rounds.sentence: Kokwana u kombe n'wana ku hlaya mali ya tinsimbi yin'we yin'we.
rounds.story: 'mali ya tinsimbi' ni 'yin'we yin'we' swi komba ku konta hi nhlayo.

rounds.sentence: Khoma nghilazi hi mavoko mambirhi leswaku yi nga wa.
rounds.story: 'nghilazi' ni 'yi nga wa' swi kombisa ku yi khoma hi voko.

rounds.sentence: Endzhaku ka ku pfumaleka ka gezi, mutjhini wa mati a wu ha fambe kahle.
rounds.story: 'mutjhini wa mati' ni 'gezi' swi komba leswaku ku vulavuriwa hi ku tirha ka wona.

rounds.sentence: Buku leyintshwa ya mufundhisi yi huma hi Ravuntlhanu lowu taka.
rounds.story: 'buku leyintshwa' ni 'hi Ravuntlhanu' swi kombisa ku humesiwa kumbe ku kandziyisiwa.

rounds.sentence: Endzhaku ka ku vabya, u tshikile ku nwa byala hi ku helela.
rounds.story: 'ku nwa byala' ni 'hi ku helela' swi kombisa ku yima ka mukhuva.

rounds.sentence: Pfalanani fasitere, moya lowu nghenaka wu hahisa maphepha.
rounds.story: 'fasitere' ni 'maphepha' swi kombisa mpfhuka lowu nghenaka ekamareni.

rounds.sentence: Mufambisi u layile vatirhi leswaku va tisa swiviko emahlweni ka awara ya mune.
rounds.story: 'vatirhi' ni 'va tisa swiviko' swi kombisa ku nyika swileriso.

kids.sentence: Foni ya manana yi rila etafurheni.
kids.story: 'foni' ni 'etafurheni' swi kombisa mpfumawulo wa yona.

kids.sentence: Vana va ya lala loko ku dzwihalile.
kids.story: 'loko ku dzwihalile' swi kombisa nkarhi wa vurhongo.

kids.sentence: Ndzi twe munhu a ba enyangweni.
kids.story: 'enyangweni' swi kombisa ku gongondza, ku nga ri ku ba munhu.

kids.sentence: Hi dya vuswa ni huku loko hi vuya exikolweni.
kids.story: 'vuswa ni huku' ni 'loko hi vuya exikolweni' swi kombisa swakudya.

kids.sentence: Loko u huma ekamareni, dzima rivoni.
kids.story: 'rivoni' ni 'ekamareni' swi kombisa ku tima gezi.

kids.sentence: Mufana u tlurile xidziva xa mati a nga nyovi.
kids.story: 'xidziva xa mati' ni 'a nga nyovi' swi kombisa ku tlula hi milenge.

kids.sentence: Yima kwala, ndzi ta vuya sweswi.
kids.story: 'ndzi ta vuya sweswi' swi kombisa leswaku u fanele ku rindza.

kids.sentence: Ndzi kumile peni ya mina ehansi ka tafula.
kids.story: 'peni ya mina' ni 'ehansi ka tafula' swi kombisa nchumu lowu kumiweke.

kids.sentence: Ndzi ta hlangana na tata exitichini xa mabazi.
kids.story: 'na tata' ni 'exitichini xa mabazi' swi kombisa ku tlhela mi vonana.
'mati' ni 'embiteni' swi kombisa ku vila hi ndzilo.
